title: Rebound
text: The keeper saves a shot but the ball bounces loose near you.
tip: Always follow your teammates' shots in.

options.text: Wait to see if the ref gives a corner
options.why: The ball is still in play. Strikers who follow up score the most tap-ins.

options.text: React fast and shoot first time
options.why: The keeper is on the floor. Hit it before they get up.

options.text: Control it, look up, then shoot
options.why: Calm, but every second lets the keeper and defenders recover.
